## About
Real Body Shop is a family run auto body shop at 14915 Oxnard St in Van Nuys. We work on all makes and models, from everyday commuters to classic cars and expensive cars with special paint jobs.
When your car comes in after a collision, the first thing we do is write a complete estimate of the damage. From there we handle the bodywork, paint, dent removal, wheels and headlights so your car goes home looking right.
Customers have given us a Google rating of 5 from 20 reviews. One customer said it best: they live in Los Angeles but still make the trip when they need work done.

## Services
- Auto body repair: Body repair for all makes and models. When your car arrives, we start with a complete written look at the damage before any work begins.
- Paintless dent removal: Dents taken out without repainting the panel.
- Wheel repair: Repair for bent, cracked, broken or curb rashed wheels.
- Head light restoration: A cleaning service for foggy headlights so they shine the way they should and you can see the road ahead.
- Mercedes sunroof repair: Sunroof and moon roof repair for any year or model of Mercedes Benz, backed by our guarantee on the job. Make an appointment for a complete inspection.
- Classic car restoration: Restoration and refinishing for classic cars, with the goal of making them as good as the year they were made.

## FAQ
Q: Is the consultation free?
A: Yes. Bring your car in and we will take a look at it for a free consultation.

Q: Do you work with insurance companies?
A: We work with any insurance company that respects your right to choose your own shop.

Q: Can you help me get a rental car?
A: Our staff can take care of your rental needs through our service partners at Hertz Car Rental or Enterprise.
